subject: Commercial exception request: Acme Diagnostics – multi-zone pilot pricing
messages:
From: Alison Byrne <alison.byrne@acmedx.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmedx.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot pricing request and RFP

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team at Acme Diagnostics is keen to run a three-region pilot (East/West/EMEA mirror) for our image-annotation assistant. We like Redwood's latency profile but the procurement team pushed back on the initial TCV.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a 45% discount on list for the first 6 months of the pilot, and can we consolidate billing to a single org invoice to align with our procurement cadence? I attached our RFP for context — the pilot is timeboxed and we expect to expand if technical SLAs meet our benchmarks.

Would you be able to route this for an approval path? We need a written commercial exception to include with our procurement submission by Friday.

Best,
Alison Byrne
Head of Product Operations
Acme Diagnostics

Attachment: Acme_RFP_Q3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing request and RFP — requesting commercial exception review

Team,

Forwarding Acme Diagnostics' ask — they are explicit: 45% off list for 6 months and consolidated invoicing. Pilot is three-region but initial usage estimate is modest (~$12k/month run rate ramping).

Why this matters: Acme is a strategic channel for clinical imaging; if pilot succeeds we could convert to a 3-region Dedicated commitment. I need a commercial exception + CFO/VP signoff language we can provide to procurement by EOD Friday.

Proposal (my recommendation):
- 40% list discount for the first 6 months (conservative from their ask)
- Conditional on a signed mutual action plan and a commitment to a technical review at 90 days
- Single-entity invoicing to our standard SOW template, 30-day payment terms

Please see the attached quick margin calc from Kimberly and a draft of special-terms language. Kimberly — can you confirm margin impact and if any guardrails (usage floors, rate cards) we should require? Marissa — can you confirm precedent risk and whether exec clearance is needed beyond CFO? Karthik — requesting your review for VP/CFO signoff.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: special-terms-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing request and RFP — margin & guardrails

Vivek — quick read on numbers attached (margin-model-acme.xlsx). Bottom line: a 45% flat list discount for 6 months would push gross margin below our standard pilot threshold (~35%) given the three-region deployment and expected token volumes. A 40% discount combined with the following preserves economics: 
- Minimum monthly usage floor of $8k for months 1–3, then true-up at month 4 if below floor
- Limit the deep discount to the first 100 million tokens across all regions, after which we revert to standard pilot pricing
- No perpetual price guarantees in the SOW; discount explicitly timeboxed to 6 months

These guardrails make the ask workable. Also recommend including a clause that any Dedicated conversion requires a fresh commercial review.

I can sign off on a margin-preserving exception if legal updates the SOW language per the above.

-Kim
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: margin-model-acme.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing request and RFP — executive clearance request

Karthik — Vivek/Kim have outlined the commercial terms and guardrails. Two additional points from a precedent and revenue-protection perspective: 
1) This deal, if approved at 40% plus floors, establishes a lower bound that other reps might reference for healthcare pilots — suggest we record the final memo in the commercial exceptions ledger with a short rationale.
2) Consider adding a clause for a 10% early-conversion uplift (applied retroactively) if Acme converts to a Dedicated contract within 9 months — protects economics and deters cherry-picking.

If you are comfortable, please provide VP/CFO signoff language or mark any conditions. We need to communicate a firm answer to procurement by COB Friday (16 Jul).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing request and RFP — executive clearance request

Team,

Approved with conditions. Executive signoff: Redwood will grant a one-time commercial exception as follows: 
- 40% off list for the first 6 months of the pilot, limited to the first 100M tokens across regions
- $8k minimum monthly consumption floor for months 1–3, with a true-up at month 4 if not met
- Consolidated billing to one Acme entity for pilot period; standard 30-day payment terms
- If Acme converts to Dedicated within 9 months, apply a 10% conversion uplift retroactively to the pilot period (to be credited on the first Dedicated invoice)
- Legal to insert explicit timebox and no-perpetuity clause in SOW; commercial exceptions ledger entry required

Marissa — please route the final memo and SOW language to Legal and cc me. Vivek — respond to Alison with the approved terms and attach the commercial exception memo once Legal finalizes language.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Finance & Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
